education.description:
Back home where it all started.
http://www.redditblog.com/2014/11/coming-home.html

Executive chair until coming back full-time in July 2015.
Helping founders make something people love.
I help make it rain on our non-profit's bank account.
I'm writing a book for aspiring entrepreneurs eager to embrace the future of the World Wide Web for fun, profit, and for the good of humankind.

Breadpig, Inc. was founded with the purpose of being an uncorporation. Rather than following the typical corporate directive of maximizing shareholder wealth, breadpig aims to do interesting (good) things with its profits. Don't tell our shareholders.
Invest, advise, consult and sometimes play video games.
Got paid to read, as well as provide impeccable customer service to all the patrons of the parking garage. Responsible for giving proper change and keeping the booth tidy.

Started as a dishwasher and got promoted to cook after my first shift. Cooked for a year and asked to serve so I could make more money. Waiting tables was a great experience because of the emphasis it places on customer service  since basically your entire income is riding on it (which is why its a good idea to tip well). Nowadays, helping a user with a bug in the code is much easier than helping a customer with one in their food.

Graduated with high distinction in History, thesis titled "Is There Nothing Intelligent to Say About a Massacre? Conflicting Contemporary Perceptions of the Bombing of Dresden." Ask me about this (or anything from 20th century European history) sometime, if you want to excite me.

Also graduated with a B.S. (yes, a B.S.) in Commerce, concentrating in management and international business -- now I'm looking for an international business to manage.

Minored in German, but this was kind of cheating since my mom is from Hamburg.
